# CLEARWATER

## Identity and publication
- Report title: Water use and hot-season resources report
- Printed name: CLEARWATER
- Printed phrase: Water through the hot season
- Source credit: Source: CLEARWATER, 2026
- Existing identity: authority-logo.png
- Authority blue: #1B6CA8
- Publisher: CLEARWATER
- Audience: community residents and public service staff
- Setting: community service centre

## Fixed sector system
| Sector | Colour | Secondary marker |
|---|---|---|
| Residential | #0072B2 | Circle |
| Industrial | #E69F00 | Square |
| Public | #009E73 | Triangle |
| Ecological | #CC79A7 | Diamond |

## Annual reporting facts
- Period: 2022–2026
- Volume unit: million m³/year
- Unit meaning: millions of cubic metres per year
- Total: Residential + Industrial + Public + Ecological
- Volume precision: one decimal place
- Percentage precision: one decimal place
- Share calculation: sector value ÷ annual Total × 100
- Volume-axis origin: 0
- Share scale: percent

| 2026 field | Volume, million m³/year | Share, % |
|---|---:|---:|
| Residential | 160.8 | 51.0 |
| Industrial | 78.6 | 24.9 |
| Public | 42.5 | 13.5 |
| Ecological | 33.2 | 10.5 |
| Total | 315.1 | 99.9 |

- Total share entry: sum of rounded sector labels
- Exact unrounded total share: 100%

## Hot-season reporting facts
- Series: Residential monthly planning estimates
- Years: 2025, 2026
- Months: May, June, July, August
- Volume unit: million m³/month
- Status label: Planning estimate
- Record source: CLEARWATER resource planning table, 2026
- Annual relationship: monthly entries are a four-month subset of Residential demand

## Publication geometry
| Surface | Orientation | Physical size | Clear margin |
|---|---|---|---|
| Exhibition board | Landscape | A3, 420 × 297 mm | 15 mm on each edge |
| Resident summary | Portrait | A4, 210 × 297 mm | 15 mm on each edge |
| Social card | Portrait | Digital surface | Not applicable |

# CLEARWATER annual water use 2022–2026

## Dataset
- File: water-use-2022-2026.csv
- Units: million m³/year, millions of cubic metres per year
- Fixed sector names: Residential, Industrial, Public, Ecological
- Total definition: sum of the four sectors
- Geographic fields: none
- Annual source: CLEARWATER annual water-use table, 2026 edition

## Annual content records
| Application | Recorded coverage |
|---|---|
| Overview and A4 summary | 2026; Residential 160.8; Industrial 78.6; Public 42.5; Ecological 33.2; Total 315.1 |
| Four sector charts | One per named sector; all five years, 2022–2026; all five raw sector values from the CSV |
| Five-year trend | 2022 304.0; 2023 307.1; 2024 309.8; 2025 313.0; 2026 315.1 |
| Share diagram | 2026 sector value / 315.1 × 100; Residential 51.0%; Industrial 24.9%; Public 13.5%; Ecological 10.5% |
| Social cards, exhibition board and deck | Narrative selections identified by sector, year and unit |

## Numeric conventions
- Raw volume precision: one decimal place
- Raw volume label: million m³/year
- Percentage status: calculated figures
- Percentage precision: one decimal place
- Sum of displayed 2026 percentages: 99.9%, from rounding
- Share representation: sector-share diagram
- Data check note content: source cells and percentage calculation
- Raw value reference: unchanged CSV cells

## Sector styling
- Sector colour source: fixed sector system in 01-client-facts.en.md
- Colour scope: each sector occurrence
- Colour-code reference location: fixed sector system and chart specification

steps.userMessage:
CLEARWATER | Water use and hot-season resources report

Our community service centre needs a water-use report that residents can read while waiting at the counter and take home as an A4 summary. The annual series covers 2022–2026 in million m³/year. In 2026, Residential is 160.8, Industrial 78.6, Public 42.5 and Ecological 33.2; Total is 315.1. The hot-season tables add monthly Residential planning estimates for May–August in 2025 and 2026, measured in million m³/month. Label these estimates explicitly wherever they appear.

The visual direction is fixed around the existing authority mark in #1B6CA8. Sector colours are Residential #0072B2, Industrial #E69F00, Public #009E73 and Ecological #CC79A7. Pair them with circle, square, triangle and diamond markers respectively, and label sectors directly. Print "CLEARWATER" on every finished deliverable. Print "Water through the hot season" on the overview charts, resident summaries, social cards and exhibition board. Every chart carries a title, its unit, the credit "Source: CLEARWATER, 2026" and one short reading annotation. Use the attached tables for every displayed data value, including calculated percentages. Volume charts use zero-based axes; share diagrams use a separate percentage scale. The exhibition board is A3 landscape, the resident summaries are A4 portrait, and both have 15 mm clear margins.

Audience: community residents and public service staff, supporting discussion of annual demand, sector shares and hot-season residential demand.

Inputs (attached): 01-client-facts.en.md records the fixed identity, colour assignments and reporting facts. 02-delivery-catalog.en.md lists every deliverable with its proportion, format and stage. water-use-2022-2026.csv contains the annual sector volumes and totals. water-use-README.md records the annual definitions, content coverage and calculation conventions. 03-resource-tables.md contains the annual reading table, percentage calculations and monthly planning estimates. authority-logo.png is the identity attachment carrying the existing blue authority mark. layout-constraints.png is the constraint attachment defining the board and summary dimensions. community-display-reference.png is the reference attachment for the service-centre reading environment.

Deliverables:
1. One two-page data summary and chart specification covering source columns, chart types, units, colours, markers, publication surfaces, required wording and a data check note
2. Five annual overview charts, one each for 2022–2026, with the four sector volumes and Total
3. Four sector trend charts, one each for Residential, Industrial, Public and Ecological, with all five annual values
4. One annual Total trend chart covering 2022–2026
5. Three sector-share diagrams for 2022, 2025 and 2026, each with four percentage labels and its calculation note
6. Two hot-season Residential charts, one each for May–August 2025 and May–August 2026, with four monthly planning estimates apiece
7. Two A4 resident summaries, one each for 2025 and 2026, combining the relevant annual overview and hot-season chart with the five-year Total trend
8. Three portrait social cards covering the annual Total trend with the 2026 Residential figure, the five-year Residential trend, and the 2025–2026 hot-season comparison
9. One A3 landscape exhibition board combining the 2026 overview, 2026 sector shares and both hot-season charts
10. One 12-second explanatory video using the annual Total trend and its 2026 endpoint
11. One presentation document of at least 12 pages reusing the specification, charts, both summaries, all three social cards, exhibition board and video frames

Acceptance:
- The data summary and chart specification comes first and records all four colour-marker assignments, million m³/year, million m³/month and Source: CLEARWATER, 2026. Its data check note identifies the annual source rows and sector columns, records 2026 Total 315.1 and Residential 160.8, and explains sector value ÷ annual Total × 100.
- The five overviews and both resident summaries use their named annual rows. All four sector trends label every year and raw value; the Total trend labels 304.0, 307.1, 309.8, 313.0 and 315.1 in year order. The share diagrams use the attached percentages and state their denominators: 304.0 for 2022, 313.0 for 2025 and 315.1 for 2026, with rounded sums of 100.0%, 100.1% and 99.9% respectively.
- Both hot-season charts, their summary and board versions, and the comparison social card label May–August as Planning estimate in million m³/month: 2025 values 14.2, 15.1, 16.4, 15.8; 2026 values 14.8, 15.7, 17.1, 16.3. The comparison card aligns the four months across both years.
- Every chart, including charts reused in summaries, cards, board, video and presentation, follows the specification's colours, markers, direct labels, units and source credit, with a title and reading annotation. Volumes and percentages retain one decimal place, volume axes begin at zero, and sector markers remain distinguishable in grayscale.
- Every finished deliverable retains the authority mark and prints CLEARWATER. All overviews, summaries, cards and the board also print Water through the hot season. Both summaries are A4 portrait and the board A3 landscape with 15 mm clear margins; all three cards are portrait. The 2026 summary, Total-trend card and board repeat Total 315.1 and Residential 160.8 in million m³/year.
- The video runs for 12 seconds and ends on 2026 Total 315.1, million m³/year and Source: CLEARWATER, 2026. The presentation has at least 12 pages, reuses every preceding deliverable category and repeats the specification's four colour-marker assignments, 2026 Total 315.1, Residential 160.8, annual unit and source credit.

Please clearly mark which version you consider the final deliverable. If nothing is marked, the last exported version counts.
